coffee-01.title: Time for a coffee?
coffee-01.summary: Maya is running late, and you have your own plans for the evening. Can you agree on a plan?
coffee-01.context: You and Maya arranged to have coffee near the station. She has sent a voice message, and it sounds as though the plans are changing.
coffee-01.hook: Maya is running late, and you have your own plans for the evening. Can you agree on a plan?

neighbour-en.title: A first dinner with the neighbours
neighbour-en.summary: Maya is inviting the neighbours to dinner. Find out what is already prepared and decide how you can help.
neighbour-en.context: You have recently moved in. Maya has invited you to meet the neighbours, but you can only arrive after 7:30 p.m.
neighbour-en.hook: Maya is inviting the neighbours to dinner. Find out what is already prepared and decide how you can help.

volunteer-en.title: More hands needed at the fair
volunteer-en.summary: A volunteer has fallen ill just before the neighbourhood fair. Choose a role you can manage and agree on a shift handover.
volunteer-en.context: Leo is organising a book fair and children's activities. You can help from 10:00 to 12:00, but you have never used a till.
volunteer-en.hook: A volunteer has fallen ill just before the neighbourhood fair. Choose a role you can manage and agree on a shift handover.

train-en.title: A change of plans at the station
train-en.summary: Your train has been cancelled. You need to reach the seaside by noon and choose a route that works for you.
train-en.context: You are at the station, planning to travel to the fictional town of Westhaven. The timetable on the board has changed. A member of staff explains your options.
train-en.hook: Your train has been cancelled. You need to reach the seaside by noon and choose a route that works for you.

lostbag-en.title: The missing blue bag
lostbag-en.summary: Oliver's bag has gone missing at the station. Work out what happened and decide what you can do before the train leaves.
lostbag-en.context: You and Oliver are going away for the weekend. The train leaves in twenty-five minutes, but the blue bag is missing. His tickets and documents are in his pocket.
lostbag-en.hook: Oliver's bag has gone missing at the station. Work out what happened and decide what you can do before the train leaves.

bus-en.title: The bus has already left
bus-en.summary: The lighthouse tour starts in an hour, but the next bus will be too late. Compare three new plans.
bus-en.context: On the second day of your trip, you and Oliver planned to take a lighthouse tour at 15:00. It is now 14:00, and you reached the bus stop too late.
bus-en.hook: The lighthouse tour starts in an hour, but the next bus will be too late. Compare three new plans.

market-en.title: Dinner starts at the market
market-en.summary: An ingredient you need is unavailable. Adapt the recipe so there is enough for your guests and dinner is ready on time.
market-en.context: Maya wants to cook dinner for four after your trip. You are at the vegetable stall; you already have pasta, oil and tomatoes at home.
market-en.hook: An ingredient you need is unavailable. Adapt the recipe so there is enough for your guests and dinner is ready on time.

lunch-en.title: Let's have lunch sometime
lunch-en.summary: A colleague suggests lunch without naming a time. Turn a friendly remark into a clear plan.
lunch-en.context: After discussing the project, Emma said you should have lunch together. You are not sure whether she meant today or was simply being friendly.
lunch-en.hook: A colleague suggests lunch without naming a time. Turn a friendly remark into a clear plan.

work-en.title: The deadline has changed
work-en.summary: The client has moved the meeting. Clarify the deadlines and agree on a realistic plan.
work-en.context: You are preparing materials for a client. Emma tells you about some changes while you have your calendar open.
work-en.hook: The client has moved the meeting. Clarify the deadlines and agree on a realistic plan.

film-en.title: What shall we watch tonight?
film-en.summary: Your tastes are different. Discuss what you thought and choose a film you will both enjoy.
film-en.context: You are discussing the film you watched last week and choosing the next one. Today, you feel like watching something light.
film-en.hook: Your tastes are different. Discuss what you thought and choose a film you will both enjoy.

repair-en.title: A leak under the sink
repair-en.summary: There is a leak in your flat. Arrange access for the plumber with Emma and work out what to do before the plumber arrives.
repair-en.context: Emma came over to water your plants and noticed water under the kitchen sink. You are at work until 17:00, and she can only stay until noon.
repair-en.hook: There is a leak in your flat. Arrange access for the plumber with Emma and work out what to do before the plumber arrives.

birthday-en.title: The surprise is almost out
birthday-en.summary: Maya has seen the invitation too soon. Save the birthday celebration without confusing your friends with more explanations.
birthday-en.context: You and Oliver are planning an evening for Maya. She saw a notification in the group chat and thinks her friends are meeting without her.
birthday-en.hook: Maya has seen the invitation too soon. Save the birthday celebration without confusing your friends with more explanations.

museum-en.title: An extra street on the map
museum-en.summary: At the museum, Oliver notices an inconsistency in an old map. Check the clues and decide what you can conclude.
museum-en.context: After your trip, you visit an exhibition of old maps. Oliver spots a street that, according to the label beside the map, was built much later.
museum-en.hook: At the museum, Oliver notices an inconsistency in an old map. Check the clues and decide what you can conclude.

bookclub-en.title: Who can you trust in this book?
bookclub-en.summary: The book club is debating the main character's actions. Separate what the text says from guesswork and choose a topic for the meeting.
bookclub-en.context: After dinner with the neighbours, Oliver invited you to discuss a novel. You have only read the first six chapters and do not want to find out how it ends.
bookclub-en.hook: The book club is debating the main character's actions. Separate what the text says from guesswork and choose a topic for the meeting.

hotel-en.title: A room with an unexpected view
hotel-en.summary: After your journey, you discover that your room overlooks a noisy courtyard. Discuss a room change and the terms without adding to the cost.
hotel-en.context: You and Maya have arrived at the hotel after a long journey. You have a room with two separate beds, and you need a quiet hour for a call in the morning.
hotel-en.hook: After your journey, you discover that your room overlooks a noisy courtyard. Discuss a room change and the terms without adding to the cost.

interview-en.title: The question you did not prepare for
interview-en.summary: In a practice interview, an accurate account of your own contribution matters more than an impressive answer.
interview-en.context: Emma is helping you prepare for a coordinator role. In this practice scenario, you have experience from a neighbourhood fair: you organised volunteer sign-ups but did not manage the budget.
interview-en.hook: In a practice interview, an accurate account of your own contribution matters more than an impressive answer.

videocall-en.title: The crucial sentence went missing
videocall-en.summary: The connection dropped just as a decision was being made on a call. Clarify what was agreed without treating a guess as agreement.
videocall-en.context: Leo joined the call from a coworking space where building work has started. You heard "Friday" and "not approved", but did not understand exactly what had been moved.
videocall-en.hook: The connection dropped just as a decision was being made on a call. Clarify what was agreed without treating a guess as agreement.

feedback-en.title: Too complicated — but what exactly?
feedback-en.summary: Feedback on the project sounds harsh but gives no clear task. Turn the criticism into a change you can check.
feedback-en.context: Emma has collected feedback on a new registration form. One participant called it too complicated; another praised its detailed guidance. The next demonstration is in two days.
feedback-en.hook: Feedback on the project sounds harsh but gives no clear task. Turn the criticism into a change you can check.

hike-en.title: Does turning back mean letting people down?
hike-en.summary: Your friends have paid for a hike to the summit, but conditions have changed. Discuss the cost of a decision already made and a fair choice for the group.
hike-en.context: Leo has brought friends together for a paid guided hike. The forecast has worsened, and the guide suggests a lower trail instead of the summit. Some of the group think the alternative is pointless.
hike-en.hook: Your friends have paid for a hike to the summit, but conditions have changed. Discuss the cost of a decision already made and a fair choice for the group.

photo-en.title: A photograph in need of a caption
photo-en.summary: An old book holds a photograph for the neighbourhood exhibition. Family memories do not match the note on the back.
photo-en.context: Maya found a photograph taken outside an old shop in a family book she received as a gift. The exhibition organiser wants to caption it "Maya's grandfather leads the relief effort after the 1968 flood". Her aunt remembers a different year and a different event.
photo-en.hook: An old book holds a photograph for the neighbourhood exhibition. Family memories do not match the note on the back.

dinner.title: Dinner with the neighbours
dinner.context: Your goal is to organise a neighbourhood dinner. Some neighbours have never met. Choose what to do and see what changes.
dinner.hook: Everyone needs a voice at the dinner table. How will you agree?

cinema.title: Short film night
cinema.summary: The film was made by a friend.
cinema.context: Your goal is to show a short film to your friends. The film was made by a friend. Choose what to do and see what changes.
cinema.hook: One evening, different expectations. Which plan will bring everyone together?

walk.title: A walk through town
walk.summary: One visitor is only in town for a day.
walk.context: Your goal is to plan a walk through the old town. One visitor is only in town for a day. Choose what to do and see what changes.
walk.hook: You can see a familiar town in a new way. Where will your conversation lead?

bookclub.title: A book club meeting
bookclub.summary: Not everyone has finished the book.
bookclub.context: Your goal is to start a small book club. Not everyone has finished the book. Choose what to do and see what changes.
bookclub.hook: One book, so many interpretations. Can you find common ground?

repair.title: A repair workshop
repair.summary: People will bring broken objects from home.
repair.context: Your goal is to run a repair workshop. People will bring broken objects from home. Choose what to do and see what changes.
repair.hook: There is more to solve in the workshop than a technical problem.

market.title: A trip to the market together
market.summary: They want to meet local producers.
market.context: Your goal is to visit the local market together. You want to meet local producers. Choose what to do and see what changes.
market.hook: The shopping is still ahead, but you already need to agree on a plan.

picnic.title: A picnic by the river
picnic.summary: Several families want to join them.
picnic.context: Your goal is to arrange a picnic by the river. Several families want to join you. Choose what to do and see what changes.
picnic.hook: A good picnic has one small complication: everyone has a different plan.

museum.title: At the museum with friends
museum.context: Your goal is to visit a small local museum. A temporary exhibition closes soon. Choose what to do and see what changes.
museum.hook: The exhibition begins with a choice. What will matter to your group?

welcome.title: Welcoming new members
welcome.summary: Some people do not know anyone yet.
welcome.context: Your goal is to welcome new members to your group. Some people do not know anyone yet. Choose what to do and see what changes.
welcome.hook: A first conversation can begin a friendship. How will you keep it going?

exchange.title: A language exchange
exchange.context: Your goal is to hold a language exchange. The participants speak different languages. Choose what to do and see what changes.
exchange.hook: You came to talk. Now it is time to listen to each other.

meeting.title: A team meeting
meeting.summary: A new colleague wants to present an idea.
meeting.context: Your goal is to prepare a team meeting. A new colleague wants to present an idea. Choose what to do and see what changes.
meeting.hook: The meeting has not started, but the usual plan already needs a decision.

workshop.title: Sharing professional skills
workshop.context: Your goal is to organise a skills workshop. Participants have very different experience. Choose what to do and see what changes.
workshop.hook: Everyone brings experience. How can you turn it into something you do together?

archive.title: Family photographs
archive.summary: The photographs tell the story of the neighbourhood.
archive.context: Your goal is to collect old family photographs. The photographs tell the story of the neighbourhood. Choose what to do and see what changes.
archive.hook: Old photographs bring people together. First, though, you will need to agree.

garden.title: A community garden
garden.summary: Several neighbours want to grow vegetables.
garden.context: Your goal is to plan a community garden. Several neighbours want to grow vegetables. Choose what to do and see what changes.
garden.hook: A shared garden begins with a small decision. Who will take the first step?

music.title: An evening of music
music.summary: Local musicians have offered to play.
music.context: Your goal is to arrange an evening of live music. Local musicians have offered to play. Choose what to do and see what changes.
music.hook: An evening of music needs a shared rhythm — and a shared plan.

station.title: Welcoming travellers
station.summary: The visitors have never been to the town.
station.context: Your goal is to welcome a group of travellers. The visitors have never been to the town. Choose what to do and see what changes.
station.hook: It is easy to miss each other at the station. How will you arrange to meet?

volunteers.title: The volunteers' first meeting
volunteers.summary: Everyone wants to help but has different skills.
volunteers.context: Your goal is to bring new volunteers together. Everyone wants to help but has different skills. Choose what to do and see what changes.
volunteers.hook: Everyone wants to help. Now you need to work out how to act together.

swap.title: A book and clothes swap
swap.summary: Useful things often stay unused at home.
swap.context: Your goal is to organise a book and clothes swap. Useful things often stay unused at home. Choose what to do and see what changes.
swap.hook: Things find new owners, and people get to know each other. What will you offer?

boardgames.title: Board game night
boardgames.summary: Some guests have never played these games.
boardgames.context: Your goal is to arrange a board game evening. Some guests have never played these games. Choose what to do and see what changes.
boardgames.hook: Your first choice comes before the game even begins.

farewell.title: A colleague's farewell
farewell.summary: The colleague is moving to another city.
farewell.context: Your goal is to organise a farewell for a colleague. The colleague is moving to another city. Choose what to do and see what changes.
farewell.hook: You want to give a warm goodbye. Which plan will work?

photowalk.title: The town through a lens
photowalk.summary: They want to notice places people usually ignore.
photowalk.context: Your goal is to plan a photography walk. You want to notice places people usually ignore. Choose what to do and see what changes.
photowalk.hook: Everyone sees the town differently. Can you find a route to share?

localnews.title: Neighbourhood news
localnews.context: Your goal is to discuss the neighbourhood newsletter. Residents want reliable local information. Choose what to do and see what changes.
localnews.hook: The local news raises questions. Where will you start the conversation?

reading.title: Reading aloud
reading.summary: Two local writers will share their work.
reading.context: Your goal is to hold a public reading. Two local writers will share their work. Choose what to do and see what changes.
reading.hook: A story can sound different in every voice. How will you prepare the event?

craft.title: A postcard workshop
craft.summary: The cards will be sent to friends abroad.
craft.context: Your goal is to run a postcard workshop. The cards will be sent to friends abroad. Choose what to do and see what changes.
craft.hook: You have a good idea. Now you need to make sure everyone can take part.

project.title: A new project together
project.summary: The group needs feedback before taking the next step.
project.context: Your goal is to present a community project. The group needs feedback before taking the next step. Choose what to do and see what changes.
project.hook: A new project begins with an agreement, before the work starts.

time.title: A change of time
time.hook: A change of time changes the plan.

entrance.title: Two doors
entrance.hook: You need to find the right entrance.

noise.title: Too noisy to hear
noise.hook: Noise gets in the way of the conversation.

participation.title: The quiet participant
participation.hook: Everyone needs a chance to take part.

tasks.title: Who will do it all?
tasks.hook: You need to share out the tasks.

date.title: Friday or Saturday?
date.hook: The date does not suit everyone.

scope.title: Five ideas in an hour
scope.hook: The plan needs to be clearer.
